overall_assessment: Extraction works well for hivolda: all 28 random controls contain the whole plan (facts box, description, learning outcomes, organisation, requirements, assessment table) with clean line structure, correct course and year, and no chrome or junk. Uncaptured page text is only year pickers, the repeated page heading and staff names. The one limitation is that the reading list is only a link on the page, so no literature is captured.

findings.evidence: Pensumliste for emnet finn du her
findings.description: The plan page only links to the reading list (link text 'Pensumliste for emnet finn du her', in 18 places in the packet); the literature itself is not in extracted_text, so the reading_list section has no real content for these courses.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The reading list lives on a separate page or PDF linked from the course page; the selector article.content-emweb captures only the link text.
findings.suggested_fix: If reading lists are wanted, follow the 'Pensumliste' link in the url_discovery strategy and append the linked page text; otherwise document that hivolda reading lists are unavailable and drop the link label in post_fn.
